verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a choice of cloud for fully managed deployments (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure) and a BYOC option inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account where data never leaves your cloud. BYOC gives real control over where data lives, but no region picker or residency guarantee is documented for the managed service. missing for 10: explicit region selection for managed clusters, documented data-residency commitments (e.g. EU/US), a list of available regions, independent corroboration.
